name: Villager
description: The reference humanoid rig. Legs, body, two arms, head and hair as separate 32x32 layers; a helmet worn on it hides the hair and leaves the face underneath.

parts.brief: two sturdy legs in dark trousers and soft leather boots, planted slightly apart
a charcoal tunic over a pale shirt, a leather belt at the waist
the left arm, sleeve rolled to the elbow, hand open
the right arm, sleeve rolled to the elbow, hand relaxed
a weathered face with a short brown beard and calm eyes
short brown hair with a side part, sitting close to the head
